title: kbgit.py sync retries a push the forge refuses with a 5xx after a short backoff
goal: kbgit.py sync --push tells a forge-side refusal with an HTTP 5xx (remote: ... Internal API error (503), pre-receive hook declined) from a gate or race refusal through kg_sync.forge_outage(output); sync_once returns retry for such a push, so sync's existing rounds (push_tries, push_pause) retry it and name each try, and a passing landing is not stopped by a passing forge outage

run:
